title: Torrents
description: Share whole folders as torrents over Reticulum.
summary: A torrent client that shares folders instead of single files. A torrent's address is a key so its contents can change while the link stays the same. Create a torrent from a folder and share the link so others can download it. Pin a torrent to keep a full copy. The Indexers then know you hold it and the publisher's phone can sleep. Seeding goes on in the background while the app is closed.
